title: nautilocalyx kohlerioides

The therapeutic actions of Nautilocalyx kohlerioides are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiviral and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, terpenoids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in the development of new treatments for various diseases.
